cdkTimeHint: Use your device’s time zone. Leave blank for immediate availability / no expiry. These dates limit redemption; granted credits remain permanent.
cdkConfirmHint: Review the quantity, credits and redemption window. Codes are shown only once; save them before sharing.
cdkFailedBatch: Current batch: {id}. If the response was lost, find and revoke this batch before generating another to avoid duplicate grants.
cdkRevokeHint: This cannot be undone. Only unredeemed promotional codes are revoked; credits already granted are unaffected. Batch revocation includes matching codes on other pages.
cdkRevokeFailed: Revocation failed. Refresh records before retrying.
billingHint: Issue credit codes in batches and review issuance and redemption records.
cdkGrantHint: Grant promotional credits without debiting your wallet. Each code can be redeemed once for permanent credits.
cdkCustomHint: Leave blank for random codes. For custom codes, enter one per line and match the quantity. Use 8–64 letters, numbers, hyphens or underscores; codes are case-insensitive. Avoid predictable codes.
cdkTotal: This batch grants {count} credits in total
cdkGenerateFailed: Generation failed. Check issuance records before retrying. The same batch cannot be issued twice.
cdkSaveHint: Codes are shown only once and cannot be retrieved after leaving this page. Copy or download them before starting another batch. Recipients can redeem them on the billing page.
cdkCopyFailed: Copy failed. Select the text to copy manually or download the file.
cdkDownloaded: Download started. Please check that the file was saved.
cdkHistoryHint: Search batches and filter by status. Totals follow the search. Includes user gift codes; only promotional codes can be revoked. Record IDs cannot be redeemed.
overviewHint: Monitor solver performance, service versions, and request diagnostics.
issuesHint: Review feedback and track issues through resolution.
qualityHint: Manage reproduction drafts, run batches, and compare results.
skillsHint: Maintain additional notes for operator base skills.
changelogHint: Edit release notes, preview announcements, and publish updates.
usersHint: Search users and manage account status, permissions, and sessions.
searchDescription: Jump to an administration page you can access.
filterScope: Filters and pagination apply to the {count} accounts returned by this search.
noResultsHint: Adjust the role or status filters, or search by name and email again.
previewHint: Sample data · Isolated from real accounts and production services. Reload to reset.
